digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center) test harness
propositions: Cloud adapter has byte-for-byte characterization pins and extensive applier/differ corpus; DC adapter lacks value-level pins for create-path fields and only asserts shape in contract tests
DC adapter has multi-page pagination and rate-limiting (429/Retry-After) test coverage; Cloud adapter's whole-project readers have never been tested beyond one page
The ticket-type map is duplicated within adapters/ codebase and must be single-sourced with a regression guard equivalent to existing status and priority map guards
Five enumerated tests in the suite are vacuous (either contract-violating or merely shape-asserting) and must either assert their intended behavior or be renamed to reflect actual coverage

Cloud and DC adapters correctly diverge on rich text format (ADF vs wiki markup) and identity form (accountId vs name); test expectations must carry different values per vendor rather than asserting sameness
